get_case_log.summary: Pre-arrival customs check flagged SHP-1001: the shipping documents do not agree on quantity.
A customs document hold: start with document reconciliation.
Asked Evidence: Shipment SHP-1001 is on a customs document hold. Get the shipment, its purchase order, the material's inventory, and its documents; extract and reconcile the document fields.
SHP-1001: exception, ETA 2026-10-31T14:00:00+07:00; document_discrepancy (normal congestion)
PO 4500001021: 120 TO CHEM-BX40 for plant 1100 from Veltrona Chemicals GmbH
CHEM-BX40: 1100 38 t (safety 30); 1200 60 t (safety 40)
4 of 4 required documents
REC-0001: quantity differs in packing_list
- The packing list quantity differs from the invoice and the PO (reconcile_documents). - Plant 1200 holds CHEM-BX40 above its safety stock (get_inventory).
The quantity discrepancy is confirmed. Quantify the impact.
Asked Impact & Options: Predict the resolution time for SHP-1001 and assess the current plan: all orders, no transfer.
PRED-0001: 3 days (median of 93 similar past cases)
ASM-0001 all orders: coverage 1.9 of 3.5 days needed, short 32 t
PRED-0001 gives the resolution time. ASM-0001: the current plan leaves a shortage.
There is a shortage and plant 1200 holds stock. Validate a transfer of the full shortage.
Asked Action: Validate an STO of 32 t from plant 1200 for SHP-1001 with prediction PRED-0001.
VAL-0001 REJECTED: Plant 1200 would fall to 28 t, below its safety stock of 40 t. Max feasible 20 t.
VAL-0001 rejected: plant 1200 would fall below its safety stock.
Rejected by the safety-stock rule. Assess the feasible quantity, alone and with priorities.
Asked Impact & Options: With PRED-0001 for SHP-1001, assess a 20 t transfer from plant 1200 serving all orders, and the same transfer serving critical_high orders.
ASM-0002 +20 t from 1200, all orders: coverage 2.9 of 3.5 days needed, short 12 t
ASM-0003 +20 t from 1200, critical_high orders: coverage 3.87 of 3.5 days needed, covered
ASM-0002: the transfer alone is short. ASM-0003: with critical and high orders it is covered.
The feasible transfer plus critical and high orders is covered. Validate it.
Asked Action: Validate an STO of 20 t from plant 1200 for SHP-1001 with prediction PRED-0001.
VAL-0002 valid: 20 t from 1200
VAL-0002 is valid.
Status: awaiting_approval
Approved VAL-0002
Approved: create the STO and verify stock.
Asked Action: Create the STO for VAL-0002 with approval APR-0001, then verify stock positions for CHEM-BX40.
CHEM-BX40: 1100 38 t (safety 30, 20 in transit); 1200 40 t (safety 40)
STO 4500001023 created; plant 1200 is at its safety stock and plant 1100 has the transfer in transit.
Status: monitoring
Berth congestion at Tanjung Priok: the carrier moved the ETA of Cookusan Ship back by one day.
The ETA slipped with high congestion. Re-predict and re-assess.
Asked Impact & Options: Predict the resolution time for SHP-1001 again, and assess all orders, critical_high orders, and critical orders, counting the transfer in transit.
PRED-0002: 4 days (median of 21 similar past cases)
ASM-0004 all orders: coverage 2.9 of 4.5 days needed, short 32 t
ASM-0005 critical_high orders: coverage 3.87 of 4.5 days needed, short 9.5 t
ASM-0006 critical orders: coverage 4.83 of 4.5 days needed, covered
PRED-0002 is longer. ASM-0005: critical and high orders are short. ASM-0006: critical only is covered.
Critical and high orders no longer fit. Check whether more stock can move.
Asked Action: Validate a further STO of 10 t from plant 1200 for SHP-1001 with prediction PRED-0002.
VAL-0003 REJECTED: Plant 1200 would fall to 30 t, below its safety stock of 40 t. Max feasible 0 t.
VAL-0003 rejected: plant 1200 is at its safety stock; no further transfer is feasible.
Status: needs_human_decision (Decide on emergency sourcing for the deferred high and normal orders.)
